description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 each), grants [ATK, DEF, MAG and RES +30% (25s)] to all allies, grants [Attach Water 3 with Stacking], [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000], [Draw Libra Follow-Up] and Instructor +1 to the user

description.name: Bio Breath
description.text: Six single attacks (3.05 each), grants [Quick Cast 1] to the user

description.name: Occult Fan
description.text: One single attack (16.40) capped at 99999, grants [Water Ability +30% Boost 3] to the user if the user has Instructor = 1, causes Instructor -1 to the user

description.name: Attach Water 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Water Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Water 3

description.name: Draw Libra Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Draw Libra after using two of Bio Breath or Occult Fan

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands
